metadata.author: transcribed from live/runs by expansion agent
metadata.key_test: Recursive (2nd-order) fragmentation - Kosovo from Serbia, itself from Yugoslavia. Tests whether Safeguard A (Mod 1) external-admin discount is needed to push the Serbia-Kosovo P1 gap beyond the WGI margin of error (Mod 4) so the ordinal call is safe.
metadata.notes: All calls ordinal/directional; no precise MI point scores reported (proprietary normalization constants not recoverable). WGI on legacy -2.5/+2.5 scale, recorded in notes. Kosovo is excluded from FSI entirely (structural data gap).

pre_event.event_description: Kosovo's unilateral declaration of independence (Feb 17, 2008); pre-event 2007 under UNMIK administration.

context.neighbor_details: Serbia as predatory neighbor (Sept 2023 Banjska attack); Russia backs Serbia diplomatically.

Serbia.notes: WGI Rule of Law (legacy est.) ~ -0.4 region, improving post-2000; sovereign, EU candidate track. GDP per capita PPP ~$11,230 (2007). Derived: higher P1 than Kosovo on measured WGI; both below EU-core levels.

context.admin_details: UNMIK since 1999; EULEX deployed 2008 (Bonn-Powers-equivalent authority). Measured P1 > actual indigenous capacity (Mod 1 discount).

Kosovo.notes: WGI Rule of Law (legacy est.) ~ -0.5 to -0.7 region, under UNMIK administration. GDP per capita far lower than Serbia (~$6,200 only reached by 2023); remittances ~14% of GDP, aid-dependent; very high (later ~50%+ youth) unemployment. Excluded from FSI (Fund for Peace does not rank Kosovo). 2nd-order recursive fragment (Yugoslavia -> Serbia -> Kosovo); passes the capacity gate minimally, only under international scaffolding. LIVE (Mod 1) discounts measured P1 -> indigenous P1 lower than raw WGI suggests.

a_trajectory_ranking.basis: Serbia higher P1; LIVE Mod 1 discount widens the gap beyond the WGI margin of error (Mod 4).
a_trajectory_ranking.falsification_condition: Kosovo matches or exceeds Serbia's trajectory.

b_violence.prediction: Low-intensity, episodic violence, not large-scale war.
b_violence.agency_note: Mod8: this predicts RISK, not AGENCY

c_convergence.prediction: Divergence - Serbia pulls ahead economically; Kosovo stays aid/remittance-dependent.

d_failure_dimension.prediction: Kosovo's weakness = P4 (economic independence) + P1; Serbia's risk = P1/P5 reversal.
d_failure_dimension.note: Most exposed to post-hoc coding bias

e_fragment_count.prediction: Recursive fragment count manageable; no further fragmentation predicted directionally.

f_reversal_risk.prediction: Serbia reversal risk HIGH (democratic backsliding under Vucic).

g_suppression_mechanism.classification: Not a clean suppression tier; reclassified as a shift out of suppression toward recognized (if partial) statehood (Kosovo's UDI; ICJ 22 July 2010 advisory opinion held 10-4 it did not violate international law).
g_suppression_mechanism.falsification_condition: Outcome behaves as an internal suppression move down/up the tiers.

Serbia.outcome_summary: GDP per capita PPP rose to ~$26,884 by 2024. Sustained democratic backsliding (Freedom House 'Partly Free'; V-Dem 'electoral autocracy' since 2014). Banjska 2023 incident; EU accession stalled.

Kosovo.outcome_summary: Recognized by at least 110 of 193 UN member states (57%) as of 19 Dec 2025. Steady GDP growth (~50% per-capita income rise since independence per World Bank); reduced aid dependence; still highest-unemployment in the region.

result_coding_reference.CONFIRMED: Prediction matched outcome on the specific dimension predicted
result_coding_reference.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: Direction correct but magnitude, form, or timing significantly different
result_coding_reference.NOT_APPLICABLE: Prediction type not relevant to this case

analysis.overall_assessment: 5 scored predictions all CONFIRMED (a, b, c, f, g); d/e predicted but not separately scored; LIVE = STATIC ordinally but LIVE improved defensibility. Recursive (2nd-order) fragmentation did not break the framework.
safeguards_triggered: Safeguard A (external administration) - Kosovo under UNMIK/EULEX; LIVE Mod 1 discounts measured P1
Safeguard C (reversal risk) - Serbia HIGH and CONFIRMED (democratic backsliding)
Safeguard D (predatory neighbor) - Serbia (Banjska 2023; Russian diplomatic backing)
analysis.what_this_case_uniquely_reveals: Mod 1's external-admin discount was necessary to make the P1 gap exceed the margin of error; without it, Kosovo's administration-inflated measured P1 would have sat close enough to Serbia's that Mod 4 would have demanded deferring to the capacity gate.
proposed_framework_modifications: Retain Mod 1 (Safeguard A discount) and Mod 4 (margin-of-error gate); their interaction earned its keep here.
analysis.baseline_impact: No degradation; LIVE improved defensibility without changing the ordinal outcome.
analysis.phase3_note: Migrated to MI v1 + Data API references. a_trajectory/c_convergence auto-derived from real re-scored data (Mod4-gated); b/d/e/f/g/h preserved as judgment.
analysis.judgment_refresh_note: Judgment verdicts (b/d/e/f/g/h) re-examined against MI v1 real-data scores on 2026-06-28: no verdict flips (directional readings robust to the legacy->anchored vintage change); b risk-levels refreshed from real pre-P1, d augmented with the real config (weakest pillar flagged as a binding vulnerability only when below median), safeguards re-evaluated.

data_resolution: Indicators resolved live via mi.datasource (country_ref + year); no embedded copies.

lead_time.method: outcome anchored at 2024; predictor = pre-event P1 at (2024-lead); Mod4 margin + V3 consolidated-pair caution (abstain = correctly cautious, not a miss).
lead_time.note: ordinal mis-ranks from 20y lead (structural exception, not a timing effect)
